# ADR-3278: AWS tagging_compute: Documented untagged sandbox resource for experiment 6

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Short experiments sometimes precede tagging.

## Decision

Builders MAY adopt a documented untagged sandbox resource for experiment 6 (AWS-tagging_compute-6) when prototyping for under 72 hours.

## Consequences

Sandbox accounts auto-reap untagged resources.
